result.topic_en: Riemann expands the sum Σ (nx)/n (with (·) the sawtooth-type fractional-part function) as a sine series with divisor-sum coefficients for rational x, and checks the case x = 1/4 two ways: directly via the Leibniz series, and via a Dirichlet series with an Euler product, both giving π/16.
result.transcription:
$\sum_1^\infty \frac{(nx)}{n} = \sum_1^\infty \frac{\sum(-1)^{\theta+1}}{n\pi}\sin 2nx\pi$ ; $\theta$ alle Theiler von $n$ ; wenn $x$ rational.

Beispiel $x=\frac14$ ; [-$n_0=0, n_1=1, n_2=$-] $n_\varrho = 4h+\varrho$
$(n_\varrho x) = (\frac14 n_\varrho) = (h+\frac14\varrho) = 0\ ,\ \frac14\ ,\ 0\ ,\ -\frac14$
je nachdem $\varrho = 0\ ,\ 1\ ,\ 2\ ,\ 3$
folglich
$\sum_1^\infty \frac{(\frac14 n)}{n} = \frac14\left\{\frac11-\frac13+\frac15-\frac17+\dots\right\} = \frac{\pi}{16}$

$\sum_1^\infty \frac{\sum(-1)^{\theta+1}}{n\pi}\sin n\frac{\pi}{2} = \frac1\pi\sum\frac{(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}}}{n}\cdot\sum(-1)^{\theta+1} = \frac1\pi\sum\frac{(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}}\alpha_n}{n}$
wo $\alpha_n$ die Anzahl aller Divisoren der ungeraden Zahl $n$ ; man betrachte nun
$\frac1\pi\sum\frac{\alpha_n(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}}}{n^s}$ ; $n = p^{\varpi}p'^{\varpi'}\dots$ wo $p$ alle ungerade Primzahlen
$\frac{n-1}{2} \equiv \varpi\cdot\frac{p-1}{2}+\varpi'\frac{p'-1}{2}+\dots$ ; $(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}} = \left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)^{\varpi}\left(\frac{-1}{p'}\right)^{\varpi'}\dots$
$\alpha_n = (\varpi+1)(\varpi'+1)\dots$
$\frac1\pi\sum\frac{\alpha_n(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}}}{n^s} = \frac1\pi\prod\sum\frac{(\varpi+1)\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)^{\varpi}}{(p^s)^{\varpi}}$ ; $\frac{1-z+z}{(1-z)^2}$
$= \frac1\pi\prod_p\sum(\varpi+1)z^{\varpi} = \frac1\pi\prod\frac{d}{dz}\sum z^{\varpi+1} = \frac1\pi\prod\frac{d}{dz}\left(\frac{z}{1-z}\right) = \frac1\pi\prod\frac{1}{(1-z)^2}$
$= \frac1\pi\prod\frac{1}{\left(1-\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)p^{s}[?]\right)^2} = \frac1\pi\left(\sum\frac{(-1)^{\frac{n-1}{2}}}{n^s}\right)^2$ ; $\lim = \frac1\pi\cdot\left(\frac\pi4\right)^2 = \frac\pi{16}$

methods.what: Fourier (sine) series of Σ (nx)/n for rational x, with coefficients given by a signed divisor sum
Direct evaluation at x=1/4 by residues of n mod 4, reducing to the Leibniz series
Rewriting the sine series at x=1/4 as a sum over odd n of the character (-1)^{(n-1)/2} times the divisor count
Multiplicativity of the character (-1)^{(n-1)/2} and of the divisor function over the prime factorisation
Euler product for the Dirichlet series Σ α_n χ(n) n^{-s}, using Σ(ϖ+1)z^ϖ = 1/(1-z)^2, giving the square of the L-series L(s,χ_4)
Limit s→1 recovering π/16 via L(1,χ_4)=π/4

items.english: The sum of (nx)/n equals the sine series with coefficients Σ(-1)^{θ+1}/(nπ), θ running over all divisors of n, when x is rational.
